title: Diffusion High-Frequency Spectral Artifacts
description: Latent diffusion generators decode through convolutional upsampling blocks that often leave characteristic high-frequency spectral grid spikes in the 2D Fourier power spectrum, absent in physical sensor Bayer patterns.

title: Spatial Noise Residual and PRNU Inconsistencies
description: Physical camera sensors exhibit fixed photo-response non-uniformity (PRNU) noise residuals. Synthetic AI images exhibit uncorrelated spatial noise distributions, local variance smoothing, and artificial residual gradients.

title: Local Texture Coherence and Boundary Anomalies
description: Denoising UNets frequently display micro-scale semantic incoherence along fine boundaries, such as hair strands fusing into backgrounds, asymmetric pupils, irregular iris borders, and inconsistent textile tessellations.
